settings.heading: Return Policy
settings.content:
At Luxe Magics, we take pride in offering customized products made just for you. As these items are personalized, we do not accept returns or exchanges. However, if you receive a damaged or defective product, please follow these steps:

  1. Record a video of the box opening showing the damage.
  2. Email us at luxemagics@gmail.com within 24-48 hours with the video and photos.

We will help resolve the issue as quickly as possible.

Thank you for understanding!

settings.question: Do I need to download an app to scan the frame?
settings.answer: No app needed — ever. Open any camera on your phone (the default iPhone camera, Android camera, WhatsApp scanner, Google Lens), point it at the QR code, and tap the notification that appears. The video plays in your browser, instantly.

settings.question: What kind of video can I use?
settings.answer: Any video you have — WhatsApp clips, iPhone videos, Instagram Reels, Google Photos exports, MP4 or MOV files. Length can range from 15 seconds to around 5 minutes. Just send it to us via WhatsApp after placing your order and we handle everything from there.

settings.question: Can the photo and video be different moments?
settings.answer: Absolutely. The photo is what hangs on the wall — it can be any image you love. The video can be a completely different memory. Many customers use a beautiful portrait as the photo, and a candid video from the same day or a different occasion entirely as the AR layer.

settings.question: How long does the AR access last?
settings.answer: Every frame includes lifetime AR video access. Once your memory is linked to the frame, it stays linked — no renewals, no expiry, no extra fees. Ever.

settings.question: How long does delivery take?
settings.answer: Every frame is made to order. Once you send us your photo and video, we produce and ship within 2–4 working days. Delivery across India typically takes 4–7 additional days depending on your location.

settings.question: Can I give it as a gift if I don't know the recipient's phone?
settings.answer: Yes — the QR code works on any smartphone with any camera app. You don't need to set anything up on the recipient's phone. Hand them the frame. Tell them to scan. That's all they need to know.

settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer: Since every frame is custom-made, we don't accept returns based on change of mind. If your frame arrives damaged, or if there's any quality issue with the print, AR link, or packaging — we replace it immediately, no questions asked. Your satisfaction is non-negotiable.
